annotation.title_clean: Proposta di REGOLAMENTO DEL PARLAMENTO EUROPEO E DEL CONSIGLIO CHE STABILISCE REGOLE ARMONIZZATE SULL'INTELLIGENZA ARTIFICIALE (LEGGE SULL'INTELLIGENZA ARTIFICIALE) E MODIFICA ALCUNI ATTI LEGISLATIVI DELL'UNIONE
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain Union legislative acts
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: Italian-language version of the European Commission's April 2021 proposal for the Artificial Intelligence Act (COM(2021) 206), with explanatory memorandum. It sets a horizontal, risk-based framework with prohibited practices, high-risk requirements and conformity assessment, and aligns with product safety legislation such as the Machinery Directive.
key_provisions_or_claims: Horizontal, proportionate risk-based approach to AI in the EU market
Bans certain particularly harmful AI practices and restricts remote biometric identification for law enforcement
Risk management methodology defining high-risk AI systems with mandatory requirements
Coherence with sectoral product legislation (Machinery Directive, General Product Safety Directive) and liability initiatives
Builds on the 2020 White Paper and European Parliament's ethics resolution on AI, robotics and related technologies
